function.name: calculate_velocity
function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data or the ability to browse the web, so I can’t pull up a current list of releases. If you let me know a specific time period (e.g., “movies released in the last month”) or a particular region or genre, I can give you a general idea of what’s been coming out recently based on the information I was trained on.

We can provide a general answer or ask for clarification. We could say we don't have real-time data. We can provide a sample list of recent releases up to 2026? But we don't know.
